definitions.zero_arm: six arm coordinates zero, may still actively open/close gripper
definitions.near_stationary: fresh pre-state EEF displacement <= .1mm per native .05s control interval, no contact diagnosis
definitions.bridge_proxy: chronological open-to-close command transition within retained clip -> later closed+height>original scene+.03m -> subsequent bowlXY displacement>=.05m -> On/open/gap>=.06/EEFclearance>=.1 frame. Not verified grasp; gate persistence separately recorded.

boundaries: Negative-position demonstrations are present and substantial. All negative sources also have negative dy; current failures at positive dy/worldY=.3731 are not covered by the same position combination.

Every human source begins after prior policy execution, with varying pose/history. Raw whole recording is not equivalent to a home-to-completion policy trajectory. Some retained clips intentionally start holding the bowl.
